display.purpose: Voicecraft wordmark only, gradient-filled — the one deliberately expressive mark in the system.

title.purpose: Modal headings, active-profile name, card titles.

body.purpose: Compose textareas, result panels, HUD result text, prose copy.

label.purpose: Structural annotation — section/panel/field labels, HUD profile tag, status pill. Never prose.

micro.purpose: Chrome text — hints, edit affordances, keyboard-shortcut tags, list descriptions.

shadows.name: ambient-rest
shadows.purpose: In-window panels at rest (sidebar, main) — barely-there lift off the canvas.

shadows.name: floating
shadows.purpose: Surfaces that visually detach and float above other windows: HUD, modal, toast, onboarding card.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for every transition in the system — hover, focus, modal/toast enter.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Run/save action — cobalt pill, generous padding, deliberate press.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #3e79ea; color: #ffffff; border: none; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; padding: 9px 22px; border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2c65d3; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(49,97,223,0.12); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: default; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; border: none; color: #60737a; font-size: 13px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #272c30; }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: Compact 26px control — settings, copy, new-profile trigger.
components.css: .ds-btn-icon { width: 26px; height: 26px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #e3e8ea; background: transparent; color: #60737a; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: border-color 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), color 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-icon:hover { border-color: #3161df; color: #3161df; } .ds-btn-icon:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(49,97,223,0.12); }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Two-way mode switcher (Rewrite / Generate) — pill track with solid-fill active state.
components.css: .ds-segmented { display: flex; gap: 2px; background: #f0f5fe; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 3px; width: fit-content; } .ds-segmented-btn { border: none; background: transparent; color: #60737a; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; padding: 6px 16px; border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-segmented-btn.is-active { background: #3e79ea; color: #ffffff; box-shadow: rgba(63,70,75,0.1) 0px 1px 3px 0px, rgba(63,70,75,0.1) 0px 0px 0px 1px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Context field / compose textarea — shared focus signature across the app.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; font-size: 12px; padding: 9px 13px; border: 1px solid #e3e8ea; border-radius: 6px; color: #272c30; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #3161df; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(49,97,223,0.12); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #7b8e95; }

components.name: List Item
components.description: Voice-profile row in the sidebar — quiet at rest, hover reveals an edit affordance.
components.css: .ds-list-item { width: 100%; text-align: left; background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; padding: 9px 11px; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), border-color 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-list-item:hover, .ds-list-item.is-selected { background: #f0f5fe; } .ds-list-item.is-selected { border-color: #3161df; } .ds-list-item-name { font-weight: 500; font-size: 13px; color: #272c30; display: block; } .ds-list-item-desc { font-size: 10px; color: #7b8e95; } .ds-list-item-edit { opacity: 0; font-size: 12px; color: #7b8e95; transition: opacity 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-list-item:hover .ds-list-item-edit { opacity: 1; }

components.name: Floating Card
components.description: The floating HUD/onboarding/modal surface — the system's one 'above the OS' elevation state.
components.css: .ds-floating-card { background: #ffffff; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid #e3e8ea; padding: 14px 16px; box-shadow: rgba(63,70,75,0.1) 0px 21px 44px -32px, rgba(39,44,48,0.2) 0px 26px 30px -23px, rgba(39,44,48,0.05) 0px 14px 40px 0px, rgba(39,44,48,0.08) 0px 0px 0px 1px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Mono-labeled state badge — pale-slate at rest, mint-tinted once a condition (e.g. permission) is met.
components.css: .ds-status-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.03em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 5px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #e3e8ea; color: #60737a; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-status-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #a6b4ba; } .ds-status-pill.is-granted { background: rgba(137,236,176,0.25); color: #1f7a4d; } .ds-status-pill.is-granted .ds-status-dot { background: #89ecb0; }

narrative.overview:
Voicecraft reads as an instrument panel built by hand, not manufactured by a design team: the calm legibility of a cockpit (one accent color, everything scannable mid-task, no decoration competing for attention) paired with the warmth of a studio notebook (a serif gradient wordmark as a handcrafted signature, monospace labels as marginal annotations rather than corporate section headers). It is precise, calm, and trustworthy — built by a careful engineer for their own daily use, not marketed to a broader audience.

The system explicitly rejects generic SaaS-dashboard grammar: no hero-metric tiles, no gradient body text, no tiny uppercase eyebrows stacked above every section "because landing pages do this," no numbered-step scaffolding unless the content is a genuine sequence (onboarding's 3-step Accessibility grant is a real sequence; nothing else on these screens should copy that pattern by reflex).
keyCharacteristics: One accent (cobalt/iris-blue) carries all primary actions and focus state; nothing else competes for that role.
Ambient elevation, not structural: panels sit flat at rest, shadow appears only when something floats above the OS chrome (HUD, modals, toast).
Monospace, uppercase, wide-tracked labels mark structure (section labels, panel labels, field labels) — used as quiet annotation, not decoration.
A single serif/gradient wordmark is the one deliberately expressive mark in an otherwise restrained, sans-serif system.

rules.name: The One-Blue Rule
rules.body: Every interactive/primary surface uses cobalt or iris-blue — never a second brand hue. If a screen needs a second accent, that's a sign the interaction, not the palette, needs rethinking.

rules.name: The Mono-Is-Structure Rule
rules.body: Monospace type never carries prose — only short, uppercase, tracked labels that annotate structure (a section, a field, a shortcut). The moment mono type wraps to a second line, it's the wrong font for that content.

rules.name: The Floating-Only Rule
rules.body: shadow-xl is reserved for surfaces that visually detach from the app (HUD, modal, toast, onboarding). Never apply it to in-window panels at rest — that's what ambient shadow is for.

dos: Do keep cobalt/iris-blue as the only interactive accent across window app, HUD, and onboarding — one voice, three surfaces.
Do use ambient shadow for in-window panels and floating shadow only for elements that overlay other apps (HUD, modal, toast, onboarding).
Do keep mono/uppercase/tracked type reserved for short structural labels, never prose.

Do give primary actions generous, deliberate padding (pill CTAs, 22-24px card padding) even where list rows stay compact for scanability — spacious and deliberate is the target character for buttons, cards, and modals.
Do state status, permissions, and errors plainly (see onboarding's Accessibility copy) — no marketing softening.
donts: Don't introduce a second brand hue for "primary" actions — that's the One-Blue Rule.
Don't use hero-metric tiles, gradient body text, or tiny uppercase eyebrow labels stacked above every section — generic SaaS-dashboard grammar this system explicitly rejects.
Don't add numbered-step scaffolding outside a genuine sequence — onboarding's 3-step grant flow earns it because it's a real ordered process, nothing else should copy the pattern by reflex.
Don't apply shadow-xl to panels at rest inside the window app — that shadow is reserved for surfaces floating above other windows.
Don't stack nested cards or repeat identical icon+heading+text card grids — not part of this system's vocabulary today, and shouldn't be introduced as a default.
